production_fixes: Legacy World queries/live lists exclude item entities without a nonempty Beta stack before wrapping; native entity/stack stays untouched
All original vanilla block views receive their original default terrain texture indices
Living and nonliving original renderer quads share terrain/item sheet routing and sprite-local UV conversion; standard fire cells 31/47 map to native fire resources
predicate_controls: Only isolated callback fixtures replace their original per-entity Random to select bounded branches. The independent 500-tick native spawn observer keeps rates, caps, weights and RNG unchanged.

baseline_regression.symptom: Actual Bird callback dereferenced ItemEntity.stack=null for native pumpkin seeds without a Beta item mapping
baseline_regression.fixed_acceptance: Actual Bird ignores the intact unsupported native drop, rejects Beta wheat, and tames/consumes the nearest wheat-seed entity using its original predicates

limitations: Headless callback, resource and geometry proof does not establish live client appearance or animated fire-frame sampling.
The item admission rule is scoped to World queries/lists; direct or retained ItemEntity views bypassing those boundaries are not covered.
Post-Beta item ids are not added to the old registry. Native item entities and ordinary modern/vanilla rules are retained.
Hunchback autonomous following/timer transitions and Skeleton army combat/expiry remain unverified.
Native fauna still contributes to original Beta ancestry caps. Original fixed-height sampling and native population/despawn policies are unchanged.
